purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: The government-hosted 2024 ESIA describes the local Land Board and Town Council as primary land administrators; the Land Act provides the national legal framework. No Nimule public registry viewer, parcel vector layer, native ID workflow, or full geometry was verified.
registryAssessment: A 2024 environmental and social impact report hosted by the Government of South Sudan states that Nimule land is primarily administered by a local Land Board and Town Council, while the formal multi-level land-administration reforms are incomplete. This confirms local land governance but not a statutory registry, parcel database, or public cadastral service.
